description: Software testing and QA skills for Claude: 329 skills and 73 agents in 11 Claude Code plugins (packs), installed from the testland-qa-skills marketplace. Each skill covers one testing tool or technique; the install commands inside a skill set up that tool, not the packs.
rules: To install the packs in Claude Code, run `/plugin marketplace add testland/qa-skills`, then `/plugin install <pack>@testland-qa-skills` for each pack, e.g. `/plugin install testland-essentials@testland-qa-skills`.
In the Claude apps, add the marketplace testland/qa-skills under Customize > Plugins, then install the packs you need.

Pack names: testland-essentials, testland-backend, testland-api, testland-security, testland-web, testland-unit-testing, testland-ai, testland-mobile-desktop, testland-performance, testland-manual-testing, testland-leadership.
Each skill is in exactly one pack, so several packs can be installed together without loading a skill twice.
Install commands inside a skill (npm install, pip install, brew install and similar) set up the tool that skill covers in your project. They are not needed to install the packs.
